details: The cryptocurrency market is currently exhibiting mixed momentum. Bitcoin is holding near $65,000, while Ethereum is pushing towards the $2,000 mark. Spot Bitcoin and Ethereum exchange-traded funds (ETFs) have collectively attracted almost $1 billion in inflows this week, signaling sustained institutional investor demand for crypto exposure. Among major altcoins, Cardano (ADA) is performing strongly, seeing gains exceeding 7%. In contrast, XRP continues to face selling pressure, impacted by short positioning, weak spot demand, and the postponement of the CLARITY Act Senate vote until September.
title: Crypto Market Mixed: Bitcoin & ETH ETFs See Inflows, Cardano Up, XRP Down

details: Bitcoin's price has climbed above $65,000 today, following a surprising U.S. jobs report that missed expectations. A weaker-than-anticipated jobs report often suggests a potentially less aggressive monetary policy stance from the Federal Reserve, which is generally perceived as a bullish signal for risk assets such as cryptocurrencies. This economic data has contributed to a positive shift in Bitcoin's price action.
title: Bitcoin Surges Past $65,000 Following Unexpected Weak US Jobs Report

details: BTCPay Server has issued a critical warning regarding an actively exploited vulnerability within its system. This exploit could potentially allow for the draining of funds, posing a significant security risk to users. Individuals and businesses utilizing the open-source Bitcoin payment processor are strongly advised to implement immediate security precautions and adhere to official recommendations to safeguard their assets.
title: BTCPay Server Warns of Actively Exploited Vulnerability

details: A recent report from JPMorgan, cited by CoinDesk, indicates that the growth momentum observed in Hyperliquid (HYPE) exchange-traded funds (ETFs) has waned during July and early August. The report suggests that the increasing prevalence and offerings of regulated exchanges may be contributing to this slowdown, introducing greater competition and signifying a maturing market landscape for crypto investment products.
title: JPMorgan: Hyperliquid ETF Growth Slows Amid Regulated Exchange Threat

details: The anticipated U.S. Senate vote on the CLARITY Act, a legislative proposal aimed at cryptocurrency regulation, has been postponed until September. This delay, coupled with reports of ongoing obstacles despite a White House ethics accord, contributes to increased regulatory uncertainty within the crypto sector. The odds of the act's passage this year have reportedly decreased to 17%.
title: US Senate Delays CLARITY Act Vote Until September, Raising Uncertainty
